entities.name: RFC small subunit Q5UZE5
observations: Exact full-length sequence match to reviewed Haloarcula marismortui replication factor C small subunit Q5UZE5; length 325 aa, predicted mass 36.07 kDa, pI 4.48.
RFC small subunit participates in the clamp-loader complex that loads PCNA onto DNA; reference annotations include ATP binding/hydrolysis, DNA binding, replication, and DNA repair.
Pfam hits include AAA domain (PF00004) at residues 50–168 and Rep_fac_C (PF08542) at residues 235–320.
